about: Saint-Augustin-de-Desmaures is a city in the Québec City metropolitan area, on the north shore of the St. Lawrence west of Quebec City toward Cap-Rouge and the airport corridor. Suburban neighbourhoods, remaining farmland, and river shore share a municipality that grew quickly with the capital region. About 20,000 people live in Saint-Augustin-de-Desmaures.
